Goldfish only remember three seconds. True or false? Comment before the end.
A fifteen-year-old student in Australia tested it.
At feeding time, he dropped a red toy block into the tank.
At first, the fish took over a minute to swim to it.

text: Three weeks later? Under five seconds.

Then he hid the block for six days.

text: When it came back? Four point four seconds.

In England, fish even learned to push a lever that only gave food for one hour a day.
They learned the right time, and ignored it the rest of the day.

text: So, false. Some fish remember for months. Next time you forget something, don't blame the goldfish.
